terms.meaning: A small piece of data the browser stores and sends back with each request.

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports and cookie name
sections.what: Brings in the response helper and the shared cookie name.
sections.why: The cookie name must match the one used at login, so it is shared.
sections.watch_out: Renaming the cookie in one file without the others breaks sign-out.

sections.name: POST
sections.title: Sign-out handler
sections.what: Sends back a success message and wipes the login cookie.
sections.why: Makes the browser forget the login.
sections.watch_out: Clearing the cookie does not revoke a token that was copied elsewhere.

summary: Clears the login cookie to sign the user out.
purpose: Signs the user out of the app.
why: Likely reason: signing out has to remove the proof of login held by the browser.
how: Returns ok and sets the login cookie to an empty value with zero lifetime.
outputs: A success message and an instruction to clear the cookie.
risks: The session token is not invalidated on the server, so a copied cookie still works until it expires.
debug: If a user stays logged in after signing out, check that COOKIE_NAME matches the name used at login and that the path is root.
